reason: I plan a date night every second Saturday and I don't book anything I can't see real reviews and photos of. A brand-new app launching 1 November has none of that yet, so I'd keep booking the way I already do.
objection: There are no reviews or real customer photos of the events or of TROVE itself, so I can't tell whether the hosts are any good or whether the booking will actually work at the door. The R8 isn't the issue for me, it just shows up on every booking.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews and photos from past attendees on each event page, plus friends or reviewers I trust saying they booked through TROVE without problems.
